operation_details.item: The user has a lifelong aversion to mushrooms and does not eat them.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey! I saw your commit on the API refactor—nice work on reducing the latency. What are you working on today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks! I'm just wrapping up a module, but my brain is already off the clock. Thinking about what to cook for dinner—maybe a quick stir-fry.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh, a stir-fry sounds great! I have a simple recipe with chicken, bell peppers, and mushrooms. Want me to share it?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That sounds good, but I have never eaten mushrooms since childhood due to a strong personal aversion and do not include them in my diet. Could you swap the mushrooms for something else?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely, I can swap mushrooms for zucchini or snap peas—they add a nice crunch. I'll adjust the recipe. What other veggies do you like?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Zucchini and snap peas both work. I'm also partial to carrots and broccoli. I just need something quick since I have a standup at 9.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. I'll send you a mushroom-free stir-fry with carrots, broccoli, and snap peas. You can have it on the table in under 20 minutes.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That works. I'll probably add some tofu for extra protein. By the way, do you have any tips for making the sauce less salty without losing flavor?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure—try using low-sodium soy sauce and adding a splash of rice vinegar or citrus to brighten it up. A little honey or maple syrup balances the salt too.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good idea. I'll try that. Also, I was wondering if you know any good meal-prep containers that don't leak. I'm tired of wiping out my lunch bag.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I've used glass containers with snap-lock lids. They’re leakproof and last a long time. I can recommend a few brands if you're interested.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That'd be helpful. Maybe I'll pick up a set this weekend. Anyway, thanks for the recipe tweak—I appreciate you keeping it mushroom-free.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Of course! Everyone has different taste preferences, and it's easy to adapt. Enjoy your stir-fry, and let me know how the sauce turns out.
